items.rationale: A1/A2/C1/C2/C5: Ecler is a familiar concrete confectionery pastry with a dominant food sense, supported by a 2013 Romanian recipe and independent national-media use of the pastry name. C3: five recognizable incoming neighbors and 2312 reachable; C4: pastry peers rank2 and the new vanilla/chocolate core rank5, all hot. C6 warning at0.55 is explicitly accepted on recognition evidence, not hidden by changing salience. A3/A4/A7: vanilla cream and chocolate-cream variants are directly documented; no universal ingredient or regional claim is added. A5/A6: no boundary trigger, existing target or alias duplicate. Yeast43 is incorrectly warm for choux, cinnamon72 lukewarm and butter remains incomplete; these residual routes do not outrank the five direct defining/neighbor cues. Exact private/nonwinning ingredient behavior remains required. Promote this easy round with those limits.

C3: seven direct neighbors, at least five familiar, and2312 reachable; the less familiar Joffre is not needed. C4: cake2, pastry peers3 and cocoa/chocolate5 are hot. C6 warning0.56 is accepted because the name is familiar and the corrected cocoa/chocolate paths are direct; no numerical salience change. A3/A4/A7: cocoa sponge/cream and some chocolate glazes are honest variant-specific relations. A5/A6: no editorial trigger, target duplicate or synonym reskin of Ecler; ingredients and target identities differ. Sarmale67 and cinnamon50 remain overly warm, but below the clear direct core; unrelated pen773 is cold. Promote without claiming that every ranked association is realistic.

A1/A2/C1/C2/C5: Halva is a familiar concrete seed confection with a dominant culinary meaning. The Romanian manufacturer catalogue (indexed evidence; direct page had an interstitial), university food-technology material and long-running Romanian coverage support recognition. C3: five recognizable incoming neighbors and2312 reachable. C4: cocoa and qualified sunflower seeds rank2 hot, fasting-food4 and baclava6 hot. C6 warning0.50 is explicitly accepted with that ordinary recognition and two defining input routes. A3/A4/A7: sunflower and cocoa describe actual variants; sesame varieties remain possible, with no exclusive Romanian origin claim. A5/A6: fresh target, no adult/alcohol or duplicate trigger. Oven/tray/yeast45 are spurious warm preparation cues and cinnamon72 is lukewarm; direct seed/cocoa clues outrank them. Promote with the no-bake ranking noise disclosed.

A1/A2/C1/C2/C5: Înghețată is the universally familiar frozen dessert, with Romanian recipe and broad family-media evidence; its meaning is concrete and unambiguous. C3: six incoming neighbors and2312 reachable; C4: dessert2, vanilla/cocoa3, pistachio6 and milk7 form a clear hot core. C6 salience0.2826 substantially understates this ordinary word: accept the warning through actual recognition evidence, without altering that source value or treating obscurity as difficulty. A3/A4/A7: vanilla/cocoa are common flavors and milk is a conventional base, not a claim that sorbet or every variant uses dairy. A5/A6: no editorial boundary or duplicate target. Oven/tray/yeast51 and cinnamon57 remain misleadingly warm; baclava9 is too hot. Those defects stay explicit, while several more obvious defining flavors/category/base clues are direct and earlier. Promote.

A1/A2/D1: Stafide and Brânză are independently familiar foods. D2/D5: both exact shortest routes pass through a named sweet-cheese preparation, Pască or Poale-n brâu; each published recipe contains raisins and cheese. This is a meaningful ingredient-to-dish-to-ingredient bridge, not physical conversion or a generic geography/taxonomy path. D3: two credible first hops, minimum intermediate width2 and two distinct intermediate nodes, no choke point. D4: two hops supports easy. A3/A4/A7: variant-qualified raisin filling and explicit cheese relations are truthful; the two intermediate foods are distinct. A5/A6: no boundary trigger, existing endpoint pair or rejection-ledger duplicate. No route depends on the corrected Mucenici regional label. Promote with both real API alternatives, resume and exact typed forms verified after selection.
